attrs.evidence: RECORDED IN ORDER TO BE DISCLAIMED, which is why it exists as a record rather than as a sentence in a brief. This is the strength R7.1's LINEAGE-COMPLETE wording implied and that GPT-5.6 declined to claim. It requires attributing an output to specific weights, activations or tokens; nothing in this architecture needs it, and no revocation, worklist or admission decision in the Mosaic depends on it. Naming it separately is the only way SUPPORT-CHANNEL-COMPLETE can be read at its actual strength rather than at the strength a reader supplies.
